lines.text: Bora! Run, fresher, the goat is winning!
Don't look at me, I'm on lap six!
Pixel. Pixel! We live together. You can't just join a cult.
They do this every evening. Nobody knows why. Pixel won't say.
Coach, give me the whistle. I'll break them gently.
Bora! One lap. Easy lap. Baby lap.
I lied. Two.
You're not dying. I've seen dying. This is Tuesday.
You tie that boot one more time, I'm taking it home.
Good! Now do it tired. Tired is where it counts.
Give me twenty. I have arms. Bora!
Give me ten. No, twenty. I have arms.
Block C is lit. Block D is lit. Who's next? Don't make me choose.
Pixel doesn't like them. Pixel doesn't like anybody. So that means nothing.
I'm not scared. I'm fast. It's a different thing.
Fresher! You again. Good. I need a victim.
Lift on my count. One. Two. I'm not helping, I'm just touching the bar. Three.
You ate garri for dinner. I can see it in your soul.
Last set. I lied. Second last.
Big man! You fight fair or I make you run with me. Your choice.
See? You moved him. Last month you couldn't move his shadow.
He says 'float'. I say 'kick'. Do both. Bora!
You swim like a chair. A brave chair.
Pixel thinks water is a mistake. Pixel is wrong about many things.
Are you okay? I saw bubbles. I was over there!
I'll be up here. With the light. Go down, come up, simple.
An eel? A big one? …How big? No. Don't tell me. Tell me.
That wasn't me. I was on the other side. …Who pulled you out?
Pixel, what? There's nothing there. Stop it.
Drink. Breathe. You have forty-five more. Bora!
Jega! Left boot! I'm not superstitious but LEFT BOOT!
You lost. So what. You ran. Come here. Hug. Now we train.
Pixel! That's evidence! …Okay it's string. But it's important string.
Yes. What is it? Doesn't matter. Yes.
Who's left? Give me the list. I'll run it. You talk, I fetch.
Hospital says ward three is flickering. I'm going back. Don't let go of that thing.
Four trips. I'm warm now. Keep going.
Left side's mine! All of it! Don't send anyone, they'll slow me down!
Wave three? That's all? Bora!
Pixel's in my hood and she's furious. That's how you know we're winning.
Meat pie! Put it by the post. No, the OTHER post, that one's unlucky.
You on the bike, me on legs. To the gate. Bora!
Your helmet's backwards. I wasn't going to say. I'm saying.
Doctor in a lab coat is fouling me. I respect it.
Jega! The ball is on the FLOOR. Use the foot. The foot!
GOAL! Sorry, ma. Not sorry.
Two centimetres. I'll know. I measure with my heart.
Big man, your hands are soft! Why were you scaring children? This is your job!
Pixel approves. Pixel approves of nothing. Frame this day.
PIXEL. That is a man's entire career!
Sorry! Sorry! Cat! Sorry!
Ref! Don't blow that! She'll run again!
She says sorry. She doesn't mean it. She's a cat.
Jega! It's a bit wet. Left boot first. GO!
Left! She's going left! She always fakes right!
Boards! Jump! Don't think, jump!
I'm not tired. I'm never tired. I'm just very, very angry.
Who are we chasing? Doesn't matter! Bora!
He's quick for an engineer! Left at the yams!
…Oh. Okay. This one's yours. I'll wait by the road.
I'm not getting in. I'm faster outside. Drive!
Number four, close up! Number six, you're asleep! Bora!
Rain! Finally! I was getting hot.
Where were you? I looked back, your lights were gone. How did you get here before the mud dried on me?
I've got the far ones. You take them from the corridor. Don't run. I'll run.
Can. Next. Can. Next. Don't talk, breathe.
Zee. Sit for one minute. I'll shout if anything beeps.
…Okay. Now I'm tired. Don't tell anyone. It's never happened before.
Eleven laps of the mall. Two guards, they swap at the fountain every nine minutes. One of them smokes.
Nobody looks at a woman running. It's the best disguise in the world. Also I ran, so, win-win.
Robot coming through! Important robot! Move your feet, he has an exam!
He says 'simple' every bump. I love him. Can I keep him?
Left side, clear! Go go go! Bora!
I signed forty. Moving. It's a personal best.
Zee! Pixel brought you a present. It's a lizard. Don't look. Hug me instead.
Is this a race? Tell me it's a race. Bora!
Bora! I'll take the left. The left is the fast ones. Good.
Sheep! Hello! No. No. Other way. I can do this all day, I really can.
Pixel has a friend. Pixel, we are not keeping the friend.
You're doing great. You're purple, but great.
One lap. Of the courtyard. I lied, half. Half a lap. Look, we're doing it.
We can stop. Stopping is allowed. I do it sometimes. Rarely. But I've heard of it.
Pixel chose your foot. You can't move now. Those are the rules.
Don't thank me. Just keep opening that curtain.
Ice! Coming through! Nobody touch that leg!
Don't move. Don't be brave. Brave is for later. Ice. Here.
Look at me, not the knee. The knee is boring. I'm interesting.
I'll run alongside. Drive slow. Slower. A snail is overtaking you. Good.
He didn't scream once. He did negotiate with God, a little.
I was going somewhere nice. This is nicer. Bora!
Sub? Me? No. Sub him. Sub everyone. I'm fine.
I can't see the ball. I can see the moon. I'm chasing the smaller one. Bora!
Meu Deus! In a DRESS! Put it in the newspaper!
Is anyone sitting here? No? Good.
Rain is free resistance training! What are we doing?
Together. I take upstream. You take complaining. Bora!
Kick! You're a fish! An ugly fish! Kick!
Hello. You must be the tree man. Lovely forest. Very wet.
Again? No? Okay. …We could go again, though.
Bora! Pool is mine. Bring the captain.
Bora! [Let's go!] Eight laps. I'm counting. In Portuguese. You can't cheat in Portuguese.
That was seven. I don't care what language you said it in, captain.
One more lap. …I lied. Two. Your knee loves me, it just doesn't know yet.
The cat says your kick is lazy. I'm only translating.
Slow is not losing. Slow is how you get to be fast twice.
Left, right, who cares? Bora! Run!
Bora! Left boot, right boot, who cares, run! The grass doesn't check.
You're breathing like a kettle. Good. Kettles get things done.
Captain, twenty minutes. I'll count them. I only lie about laps.
The cat is on your seat. She says you can have it back when you score.
Wrong foot! He scored with the wrong foot! I'm framing the foot.
Bora! Give me fire. I'll take the far end. All of the far end.
New Site is lit! I'm not tired! I'm never tired! Don't test it!
One more lap. I lied. It's the whole campus.
Pixel won't look away from that garden. Meu Deus, cat, what?
You carry the middle. I'll carry the edges. Go.
Bora! I'll tell the market you're coming. Race you. I win.
This junction? Left. I'm the signpost now.
Three sites, no stops. Best night of my life. Don't tell the dark.
Pixel says the cats in the Garden have it handled.
Bora! Still here. Not even tired.
With the cat! Pixel, look at the camera. Pixel. PIXEL.
Bora! Five years! That's a long lap!
I drew the cat. That's the cat. It IS the cat, don't be rude.
Bora! You're up early. Wait. You're up late.
Hi hi! Pixel says hi. Pixel's lying, she's asleep.
There you are! Run with me. Kidding. Unless?
Oi! [Hi!] You look rested. Perfect. Run with me.
Tudo bem? [All good?] Yes? Great. Bora!
Bom dia! [Good morning!] I've done ten k. You've done one yawn.
Hi! Pixel's in my hood. No eye contact. She's tired of fans.
Bye! Stretch tonight. I'll know if you don't.
Go! I'll catch up. I always catch up.
Tchau! [Bye!] Drink water!
Tchau, tchau! [Bye bye!] Stretch your calves!
Até amanhã! [See you tomorrow!] Five thirty. Don't be late.
Go! I'll jog behind you. Like a coach. A scary coach.
You're the best. Second best. I'm the best.
Obrigada! [Thank you!] Pixel will repay you. In fur.
Valeu! [Thanks!] You're officially in the run club now. Sorry.
Thank you! Hug! Sweaty hug! Too late, it's happening.
Sorry! I lapped you. Again. It's a habit.
Oops. Too competitive? I'll hug you after.
Desculpa! [Sorry!] I didn't see you. I was going fast.
Look at that pace! Okay, look at it slower.
Nice form. Pixel approves. That's rare.
Arrasou! [You smashed it!] Horns up for you!
Your stamina's way up. You only complained once. Twice.
One more lap. I lied, two.
You run like the floor owes you money.
I'm competitive, not rude. I'll hug you after I destroy you.
Tired? Already? I haven't even warmed up.
Walking? On purpose? Fala sério! [Seriously?!]
You stretch like a cat who's never met a cat.
I'd race you, but I want it fair. So I'll hop.
Keep up! I'm walking. This is walking.
Vai, vai, vai! [Go, go, go!] I'm right behind you!
I'll walk slowly. Look how slowly. This is agony.
Come on! The cat's faster, and she's asleep.
I did four laps waiting. Five. Six.
Hurry! Pixel's already there, and she stopped for a nap.
Jogging on the spot for ten minutes. My shoes are bored.
Other way! Bora, turn around!
That's the farm. Unless you want to race a goat.
Eita! [Whoa!] Wrong way. Bonus lap, then.
Yes! Bora!
Obviously yes. Why are we still standing?
Partiu! [Off we go!]
Yes yes yes! Vamos! [Let's go!]
No. But ask me again after a lap.
No. But I'll race you for a yes.
Maybe. Race you for it.
Hmm. Depends. Is there food after?
Maybe! If you win. You won't. So no. But maybe!
Wait, what? Say it slower, I'm still running.
What? I heard 'run' and stopped listening.
Deal! Shake. Firmly. Good.
Beleza! [Cool!] Done. Shake. Now run.
No way. Not even for snacks. ...What snacks?
Not even for pão de queijo [cheese bread]. ...Okay, for that.
I'm not fast. Everyone else is just patient.
Pixel has more followers than me. She can't even read.
My warm-up is your workout. My workout is a rumour.
Pixel did a whole lap with me today. Well. On me.
Did you eat? You look like you skipped.
Games night, Friday. You're coming. That's not a question.
Friday: board games, dance machine, arm wrestling. You're ready?
Did you drink water? Drink it now. In front of me.
Horns up! Who's next? Anyone? Anyone?
Bora! Undefeated! Hug time.
Caramba! [Wow!] Did you see that? Again!
Ganhei! [I won!] Horns up! Who's next?
Undefeated! Again! Hug queue forms on the left!
No! Okay! Okay! Rematch. Now. Don't go home.
You beat me? I'm so proud. I'm furious.
Perdi! [I lost!] Okay. Okay! Best of seven.
Nossa! [Wow!] You beat me! Again. Now. Don't go anywhere.
Oof! Sorry, I don't brake. Ever.
Opa! [Oops!] I don't have brakes. Only a horn.
Down! Up! See? Never tired.
I'm fine! The floor's fine! Bora!
Blackout! Great! Night run!
Pixel? Pixel... Two eyes. Found her.
Blackout! Torch run! Who's in?
Light! Okay, everybody up, we go again!
Light! The dance machine lives! Bora!
Rain run! Best kind! Bora!
Chuva! [Rain!] Puddles are just hurdles that wobble!
Water break! Not for me. For you. Drink.
Que calor! [So hot!] Perfect. Sweat is just effort leaving.
I eat like I run. Fast, and twice.
I miss açaí [Brazilian berry bowl]. But this suya? Suya wins today.
Que delícia! [Delicious!] Seconds! Then a lap! Then thirds!
Money? I paid in push-ups once. It worked.
Broke? Running is free. Hugs are free. Pixel is not. Pixel is expensive.
For me? You're sweet. Pixel, look!
For me? Valeu! [Thanks!] Pixel, don't eat it.
Oh! It's very... I'll give it to Pixel.
A cat toy! You get me. You really get me.
New running shoes? Nossa! [Wow!] I'm wearing them to bed.
Pixel! Leave the man's sandwich!
Lap forty. Feeling great. Feeling suspicious, actually.
Who wants to race? Nobody? Cowards. Lovely cowards.
That kitten is tiny! Que fofo! [How cute!]
Lap sixty! Still fresh! Is something wrong with me? No!
Pixel! That's not your chicken! Pixel!
Air guitar on the cool-down. Nobody saw. Everybody saw.
Que saudade [I miss it so much] of the sea. Kwari Dam will do.
Night run. Stars, no traffic, perfect.
Boa noite! [Good night!] Pixel's asleep. Shh. I'm still running.
Midnight jog. The guards just wave now. They've given up asking.
The goat's still asking for a rematch.
Twenty torches, four blocks, zero breaks. Best night.
One baby lap. Look at you now.
Freshers walk to class. Champions jog to class.
Your matric gown is longer than my run. Lift your feet!
Matric? I'll jog you there. Sweaty, but early.
Fresher! Found the gym, or are you avoiding it?
Freshers! New legs! Bom dia! [Good morning!]
You lifted! Coach saw it! I'm screaming inside.
You kept up for one whole lap! Vamos! [Let's go!]
First week tired? Normal. Come jog. It helps. Promise.
First time at the Spot? Order fast. Eat faster. Lap after.
Won my first games night here. Fresher, you're next.
First rain of the year! Everybody out! Bora!
Dawn run club! Five thirty! Bring your legs.
First week and I already know every stray cat. Priorities.
Pixel walked into the hall like she paid the fees. Respect.
Dawn run club has three members. Me, Pixel and a goat.
You float now! Baba Dam owes me a thank you.
Half-time oranges. They saved the Cup. You're welcome.
Ran the far fence all night. Still not tired. Weird, right?
Test week? Run ten minutes, then study. Your brain says obrigada [thanks].
You bought a gym membership? Go! At least show it your face.
Okada? I beat one on foot once. Don't make me do it again. I will.
Cat Committee meeting, dusk. Are you in? You're in.
Arcade tonight? Some 'MIB' is on every high score. I want him.
Prices up again? I'll run to the market. Cheaper on foot.
Mall prices? Fala sério! [Seriously?!] I'll stick to the market.
Made brigadeiro [chocolate sweets] for the committee. Pixel tried. No.
You swim now! Baba Dam says you float like a log. A proud log.
Lost arm wrestling to Big Sly. Rematch. Left arm. Bora!
Pixel's famous now. She signs autographs. With her face.
'Pixel! Pixel!' I still hear the chant in my dreams.
Diesel relay. Forty minutes. I'd do it again tonight.
Raced your okada to the gate. On foot. I won. Say it.
New Site in the dark, water for the whole convoy. Best run.
Big Sly cut my hair. It's fine. It's fine! I own caps.
Pixel stole a sock on live TV. She's a star now. Unbearable.
The mall has escalators. I take the stairs. Twice.
The mall has a dance machine. I've been banned. For winning.
Cat Committee update: fourteen cats. Pixel is chair. Obviously.
Late night? I'll run you snacks. Delivery speed: unreasonable.
You've been inside for days. Come. Sun. Now.
Come out. Sun's good. One lap. Okay, a walk. Okay, a sit.
Garri again? Fine. Garri race. Who soaks fastest?
Garri relay! Soak, sip, pass! Winning team gets more garri!
Quiet campus is weird. Run with me, make some noise.
You've been horizontal for a week. Even Pixel's worried.
You came to dawn run. In a strike. I'm going to cry.
Ganhei! [I won!] Five rounds of arm wrestling. Who's brave?
Rain on a strike day! Free shower! Free fun!
No classes, no buses. Good thing my legs never go on strike.
No lectures? Perfect. Double training.
Games night every night this strike. Nobody's bored on my watch.
Strike? Then marathon training. Day one!
Games night, day thirty. We've invented four new games. All terrible.
One lap. I lied, half. You came outside. That's the win.
A farm cat joined Pixel. They're a gang now.
Whole moonlight match, no sub. My legs said thank you.
Ice, stay still, more ice. Jega is a terrible patient.
Across the line and back. You swim like a hero now.
Long strike nights. Bring a torch. We'll walk the ring road.
You picked a project partner without racing for it? Shame.
You're famous online? Cute. Can your followers run?
Bora, senior! Look at you, wearing running shoes.
You're actually fast now. Okay. I'm scared. A little.
You beat my lap record! So proud. I'm breaking it back tonight.
Arm wrestle for the last suya? Fine. For half.
Internship tired? Ten minutes on the ring road. No emails out there.
Bora! I'll pace you. In for two, out for two.
Cook-off? I'll taste everything. Twice. For science.
Nationals energy! Horns up for the whole team!
Lost a race to a bicycle. A bicycle! Rematch. On foot.
Jega counts his pool laps wrong. I count them for him.
Left boot, right boot, who cares, run!
Fourth year and I still lap the freshers. Some joys never fade.
Pixel turned four. She had cake. She had my cake.
Freshers call me 'the one who never stops'. Accurate.
Pool laps with Jega. He counts in Hausa, I count in Portuguese. Chaos.
Late lab? I'll walk you back. Jog you back. Same thing.
Night run past the hackathon. I cheered through the window. They screamed.
Promise you'll keep running after. Even a little.
Project stress? Run with me. Problems shrink at the far bend.
Graduating? You still owe me a rematch. Forever.
Defence tomorrow and you want a race? ...Yes. Obviously. Bora!
From one baby lap to this. So proud. Horns up.
Final year and still at dawn run. Força! [Be strong!]
Last dawn run? No. Never last. Just next.
No tchau [bye]. Only até logo [see you soon].
Final years! Bora! One more lap. You know I lied.
Oi, finalist! [Hi, finalist!] Horns up! Look how far you came.
Last plate at the Spot? We eat slowly. For once.
Last plate of suya? Que saudade [I miss it] already.
Last games night. I won. Of course. Hug queue, please.
Lantern line, far end, all night. Worth every step.
Three sites by road. I ran between them. Twice.
Final year. I'm not crying. It's sweat. From my eyes.
Final year. Every lap feels like a goodbye. So I'm doing extra.
Pixel is retired. She retires every afternoon. In the sun.
Last nights here. Let's walk slowly. Just this once.
Oi! [Hi!] You're back! Run with me. For old times.
Dawn run club is forty people now. Pixel still leads.
Pixel adopted three strays while you were gone. Typical.
Games night's still Fridays. Same games. Same winner.
Still running? Even a little? Tell me yes.
Homecoming race! I won! Bora! Who's next?
You're fast now. Really fast. I'm faster. But wow.
Até logo! [See you soon!] Keep your legs moving. Your heart too.
Freshers! New legs! Dawn run club, sign here!
Freshers! Dawn run club! Free water! Free cat!
Study an hour, run ten minutes. Your brain loves it. Trust me.
Exam week? I'll bring snacks and a stopwatch.
Exam week: sleep, eat, jog, then write. Boa sorte! [Good luck!]
Good, bad, whatever. We run it off together.
Results! Parabéns! [Congratulations!] Or we run it off. Both work.
Allowance day! Shoes or food? ...Both. One shoe.
Allowance in? Buy fruit. Buy water. Then dance.
Market day! Race you to Mama Nkechi's. Go!
Market day! I'll run your shopping home. Fast. Mostly unbroken.
Pixel came to market. She's haggling for fish. She's winning.
Strike day? Sports day. Bora!
Strike sports day: sack race, tug of war, cat herding!
Strike? Not me. My legs are working full time.
Cup day! I'm on the bench with the water and a loud voice.
GOL! [Goal!] Did you see? I jumped so high!
I'm the water, the cheering and the noise. Bora!
I'd run for office. Literally. Around the office.
Vote! Then run. Democracy is cardio.
Can you run in a gown? Let's find out!
Gowns everywhere! Que lindo! [How lovely!] I'm crying. It's sweat.
Run club after iftar this month. Easy pace, lots of water.
Sunset! I'm running dates to every table. Fastest delivery on campus.
Merry Christmas! Pixel has a tiny hat. She hates it.
Feliz Natal! [Merry Christmas!] Pixel's got a bow. She's furious.
Valentine's? Pixel brought me a dead leaf. True love.
Valentine's? Pixel and I have plans. A long run, then fish.
Harmattan mornings! Cold air, dusty roads, best runs!
Cold harmattan air! My lungs say obrigada! [thank you!]
